rule_basis: Pilot of the six-field confidence folders + EQL derivation (BPLUS_DATA_SCHEMA_PROPOSAL, design-stage) on R&D data. rooms_db.json and production are NOT touched. EQL is computed from evidence, never manually assigned; admins may only downgrade, never upgrade past evidence.

set.name: Moradi real-content set (one house)
set.one_house_rule: owner law — all scenes from ONE house; C7360 excluded (different house)
set.license: R&D-only benchmark; any public deployment requires the photographer's permission
set.selection_funnel: 16 posts -> -1 md5 duplicate (Kitchen_2) -> -1 other house (C7360) -> -3 reserves (kit3a, bed2b, bed3b) -> 10 scenes

reserves.kit3a: kuula.co/post/L8J1y — service kitchen, glass doors on both seam edges
reserves.bed2b: kuula.co/post/L8JTl — second view of the child bedroom
reserves.bed3b: kuula.co/post/L8JTd — second view of the pink bedroom (arched door)

excluded.C7360: kuula.co/post/LxFdY — different house (style markers, upload bundle, washer-in-cabinet)
excluded.Kitchen_2 duplicate: same post uploaded twice; md5-identical -> one unique source

at_rest.basis: single-node 4K equirect rotation on the labs harness

in_motion.basis: VQ 1.1 gaussian splat layer (experimental path) — R&D-only, owner-review page, never presented as production

eql_2_blockers: no metric node positions (Kuula publishes no capture positions)
no measured inter-node distances or doorway graph
same-space pairs are cross-validation instruments, not navigation links
eql.engine_independence: EQL-1 (Zero-Warp 0.08 m envelope) is a DIFFERENT engine and is not applied to this set; the three engines never merge (owner law).

movement_envelope.transit_note: small holes only in mirror/wardrobe quadrants beyond 1.0 m
movement_envelope.measured_basis: ladders on moradi_bed1a (mx/px) + moradi_main3 (pz) + set-wide @0.75 m battery + VLM on 3 riskiest rooms

harness_default_change.rule: envelope numbers come from measurement (new rule 2026-11-07)

worst_of_set.cause: glazed double doors + heavy patterned curtains (not the predicted seam mirrors)

fidelity_summary.double_edge_note: negative excess = no double edge; measured in all 40 scene-dir cells
fidelity_summary.dot_note: same order as the cabin same-code reference

prediction_scorecard.honest_note: directional failure-family calls 11/12 confirmed; PSNR bands systematically pessimistic on mirrors/seam — the engine was better than feared

eql.basis: rest = single-node 4K equirect rotation (labs harness); motion = VQ 1.1 gaussian splat layer, EXPERIMENTAL path, R&D-only

panorama.source: kuula.co/post/L8JZk — Mojtaba87 (R&D-only benchmark; any public use requires the photographer's permission)
panorama.measurement_method: 4K equirect download; md5 dedup within the profile set (Kitchen_2 duplicate removed)

splat_geometry.source: DAV2-small ONNX monocular depth -> VQ 1.1 locked projection (method lock, no per-scene tuning)
splat_geometry.measurement_method: AI depth estimation — no physical scene measurement exists
splat_geometry.confidence: medium (fidelity independently MEASURED at 0.75 m, see fidelity folder)

metric_scale_k.source: k_solver on DAV2-small relative depth + pano geometry assumptions
metric_scale_k.measurement_method: monocular depth scale heuristic (CAM_H 1.5 m anchor)
metric_scale_k.confidence: low-medium — never to be presented as measured dimensions

fidelity_0p75m.source: exp2 battery — settle-aware native-DPR stills (set-wide: 10 scenes x 4 dirs x 3 modes @0.75 m + 2 full distance ladders = 160)
fidelity_0p75m.measurement_method: PSNR vs 4K pano reference at 0.75 m; hole/bleed/dot/double-edge pixel statistics

movement_envelope.source: set-wide @0.75 m battery (this scene included) + full distance ladders on moradi_bed1a (mx/px) and moradi_main3 (pz) anchor the curve (PRIME 0.2-0.6 / ACCEPTED 0.75 / TRANSIT 1.0-1.3 m)
movement_envelope.measurement_method: distance ladder 0.2->1.3 m with settle-aware captures; VLM confirmation on the 3 riskiest rooms
movement_envelope.note: harness default clamp now equals this measured value (was 1.3 = TRANSIT edge)

value.layout: open-plan lounge with seating arc around central coffee table, kitchen and second lounge visible left, hall right

vlm_room_survey.measurement_method: visual inspection of the equirect; u = horizontal position on the pano seam
vlm_room_survey.note: observational, not measured geometry — estimated data never grants movement rights
